convert_detic_to_mmdet: convert a Detic model checkpoint to MMDetection format by remapping layer keys and saving the new checkpoint
correct_unfold_reduction_order: correct the reduction order of a weight tensor by reshaping and reordering channels for Transformer backbone compatibility
correct_unfold_norm_order: correct the normalization order of a tensor by reshaping and reordering channels for Transformer backbone compatibility
convert_fpn_layers: convert FPN layer keys from Detic naming to MMDetection neck layer naming using the conversion dictionary
convert_rpn_layers: convert RPN head layer keys from Detic CenterNet naming to MMDetection RPN head naming using the conversion dictionary
